headline: Norfolk Southern Reports Record Third-Quarter Revenue as Rail Volumes Offset Fuel Headwinds
summary: Norfolk Southern posted record quarterly revenue alongside safety gains, which helped offset fuel headwinds during the third quarter.
why: Class I freight railroads are essential bellwethers for North American supply chains and industrial freight demand.

impacts.name: Norfolk Southern Corporation
impacts.why: Record topline revenue and operational improvements cushioned the impact of higher fuel expenses.
